## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
The *Vipākattika* ("The Triad 'karmically resultant, etc.'") is a section of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and final treatise of the Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral; Nyanatiloka 1938]. It constitutes one of the twenty-two primary triad divisions (*tika*) in the *Tika-Paṭṭhāna*, systematically investigating phenomena categorized under karmic resultants, states productive of resultant, and states that are neither [Nyanatiloka 1938]. Like other triads in the collection, its analysis proceeds through standardized structural chapters (*vāra*), such as the chapter on investigations (*pañha-vāra*), being conjoined (*saṃsaṭṭha-vāra*), and being associated (*sampayutta-vāra*) [Nyanatiloka 1938].
SuttaCentral lists one modern translation of the text and records no curated parallels [SuttaCentral]. Automated text-reuse analysis conducted by DharmaNexus indicates extensive formulaic overlap within the Pali canon across 130 texts (comprising over 31,000 matches), sharing its largest text-reuse blocks with other sections of the *Paṭṭhāna*, notably the *Kusalattika* (Patthana 1.2), *Vitakkattika* (Patthana 1.7), *Piṭṭhiduka* (Patthana 2.13), *Hetugocchaka* (Patthana 2.1), and a parallel treatment in *Vipākattika* (Patthana 13.3) [DharmaNexus]. In cross-language matches, DharmaNexus automatically aligns passages of the text with Northern Abhidharma and Yogācāra treatises, including Vasubandhu's *Abhidharmakośabhāṣya* and its Tibetan commentaries (*Abhidharmakośaṭīkā*, *Abhidharmakośaśāstrakārikābhāṣya*), Asaṅga's *Abhidharmasamuccaya*, the *Yogācārabhūmi* (including the Sanskrit *Śrāvakabhūmi*), Ghoṣaka's *Abhidharmāmṛta*, and Vimalamitra's *Vibhāṣāprabhāvṛtti* [DharmaNexus].
